answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an onyx bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every falcon settlement recomputes the juniper schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 27 dollars per alias.
